propositions: Establish nested `rebar bridge` CLI with functional `preview` (read-only, dry-run) and `sync` (mutating, live) verbs only, deferring other verbs to later stories
Preview verb must perform zero Jira writes and zero ticket or bridge-state writes; sync verb must perform persisted mutations from unbound remote-only issues while preserving unrelated state
Reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and arbitrary trailing arguments to prevent overriding the read/write distinction between preview and sync
Help text for bridge, preview, and sync must exclude internal vocabulary: mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store, and numeric exit-code values
Unknown nested verbs must fail with valid choices and never dispatch a same-named top-level command
Legacy top-level verbs (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor) and their routing behavior remain unchanged; update CLI reference docs and exit-code tables for staged surface only
